description: A hybrid (SSE or stdio) MCP server for the LG ThinQ Connect Route API and Device API.
name: io.github.StefH/mcpserver.ThinQConnect

package_arguments.name: --country
package_arguments.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used for ThinQ requests, for example US or GB.

package_arguments.name: --pat
package_arguments.description: ThinQ Personal Access Token used for Device API requests.

package_arguments.name: --servicePhase
package_arguments.description: ThinQ service phase for Route API calls. Defaults to OP.

package_arguments.name: --clientId
package_arguments.description: Optional client identifier sent as x-client-id.

package_arguments.name: --baseUrl
package_arguments.description: Optional ThinQ API base URL override. When omitted, the server resolves it via the Route API.

package_arguments.name: --stdio
package_arguments.description: Run this MCP server as stdio.

package_arguments.name: --sse
package_arguments.description: Run this MCP server as SSE.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_COUNTRY
environment_variables.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used for ThinQ requests.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_PAT
environment_variables.description: ThinQ Personal Access Token used for Device API requests.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_SERVICE_PHASE
environment_variables.description: ThinQ service phase for Route API calls. Defaults to OP.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Optional client identifier sent as x-client-id.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Optional ThinQ API base URL override.
